nodes.name: Intake Inbox Poll
nodes.notes: Polls the dedicated nda-intake@ inbox once per minute. Downloads attachments inline so downstream nodes can stream the .pdf / .docx body to Claude.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  counterparty_id,
  counterparty_name,
  risk_tier,
  preferred_paper,
  notes
FROM counterparty_registry
WHERE primary_domain = $1
  OR $1 = ANY(secondary_domains)
LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Counterparty Lookup
nodes.notes: Returns null row when domain is unknown. Downstream code defaults missing rows to risk_tier='unknown'.

nodes.name: Claude — Playbook Check
nodes.notes: Sends the .pdf or .docx as a base64 document block. Sonnet 4.6 handles both. Cap at 2048 output tokens — clause JSON typically lands at 800–1200 tokens.
